cacheVariables._comment_hardening: libc++ bounds-checks operator[], .front() and friends. Free, no dependency, and the render path indexes snapshot.channels and snapshot.mixerTracks on every block.

cacheVariables._comment: ASan and UBSan share a build; TSan cannot join them and has its own. No leak detection: detect_leaks is unsupported on Apple Silicon, and it would report nothing here anyway - there is no manual delete in the tree.
For the three hand-rolled lock-free primitives: SnapshotBridge, PreviewQueue and SignalTap. Mutually exclusive with ASan, which is why it is a separate preset and a separate build directory.

configurePresets.name: dist
configurePresets.displayName: What a release is built from - no tests, universal on Apple

cacheVariables._comment: Tests OFF because a package has no use for them and their JUCE build is most of the cost. THIRD_PARTY.md OFF because it is written into the SOURCE tree at configure time and records the toolchain that wrote it - a packaging build would leave the tree dirty for a reason that has nothing to do with the dependencies. Universal ON because GitHub's macOS runners are Apple Silicon and an Intel Mac would otherwise get nothing.

configurePresets.name: dist-windows
configurePresets.displayName: dist, built by the Visual Studio generator

cacheVariables._comment: The generator is the whole difference. Ninja needs cl.exe on PATH, which on Windows means a developer command prompt - so a Ninja build there would need either a third-party action to set the environment or a hard-coded vcvars path that differs between the runner images. The Visual Studio generator finds its own toolchain, so this needs nothing installed and nothing pinned.
